Area D - SFOW (L28/D01).description:
Area D Sectors: 

Sutro (4U): Sutro works west and southbound departures from SFO. 

Richmond (4R): Richmond works north and eastbound departures from SFO. 

Diablo (4D): Diablo is a low altitude sector that works prop departures from OAK and a large amount of VFR traffic around the northern San Francisco Bay. 

Fairfield (4F): Fairfield is a secondary departure sequencing sector that merges north and eastbound departure traffic from SFO, OAK and SJC. 

Quake (4Q): Quake is a secondary departure sequencing sector that merges west and southbound traffic from SFO, OAK and SJC.
